lastCompletedStory.title: Make the US-R1-002 patterns.md citation rot-proof by dropping its stale line number

nextStoryContext: US-001 (CAM-380) is doc-only: dropped the stale `:769` line-number suffix from the US-R1-002 bullet at scripts/cam/patterns.md (the bullet about `recordedSleeps.every` being vacuous on empty collections), rewording the sentence so the pointer anchors purely on the assertion's content (`recordedSleeps.every((ms) => ms === POLL_INTERVAL_MS)`) instead of a line number. No new absolute line number was frozen anywhere (derive-don't-freeze honored). The sibling US-003 bullet a few lines above (patterns.md:907, citing `test/dispatch.test.ts:754`) is a separately-tracked, intentionally untouched citation -- do not conflate the two or 'fix' :754 as part of this lineage.
